name: We Gotta Get Out of This Place

podcast.body: Co-written by Barry Mann and Cynthia Weil, this song was originally intended for The Righteous Brothers. The Animals heard Mann's piano demo and recorded their version first, shelving Mann's. The group significantly reworked the melody, lyrics, and completely excised an "overlong bridge," transforming a "decent song into a great one" and "one of the greatest singles of all time," despite Cynthia Weil's strong dislike of their changes. "We got to get out of this place, have been bitten by Barry Mann and Cynthia Wile, and had originally been intended for the righteous brothers, but they decided to have Mann record it himself."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
